name: Windows Blank Passwords Limited to Console Logon
description:
Ensures accounts with blank passwords can only be used at the console (LimitBlankPasswordUse = 1), never over the network or Remote Desktop.
Required Windows permission (remedy only): the LEA agent account must be allowed to run reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa" /v LimitBlankPasswordUse (administrator rights) via a delegated run-as permission, Scheduled Task, or service configuration.

_remedy.command: reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa" /v LimitBlankPasswordUse /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f | Out-Null; reg query "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa" /v LimitBlankPasswordUse
